description: Boolean Toggle -> UI Bridge.Enable, UI Bridge.Schema -> Context Bake. The minimal wiring BridgeOrchestrator requires: an unwired Schema output is the error path at BridgeOrchestrator.cs:216.

components_note.ae2531b4-bab2-4bb1-b5bf-f2143d10c132: Context Bake (ships with Rhino/Hops, not Selva)

scaffold_note: Placing the UI Bridge alone auto-creates a pre-wired Boolean Toggle and Context Bake — the whole graph below, from one placement. Placing all three explicitly yields 5 objects and duplicate wires into Enable. The toggle and bake entries here document intent; place only the bridge.

expect.note: Counts describe the finished canvas, not the number of placements — see scaffold_note. Verify with g1_get_canvas_graph.

embedded_schema: The committed .ghx also stores an authored Schema item (serialized UI schema JSON) in the UI Bridge Container chunk. A rebuild starts empty — the component reads "Offline • No Schema" — so graft it back onto _embeddedSchema before saving, and restore the "UI Bridge" nickname (a fresh instance defaults to "UIBridge"). See the rhino-mcp skill.
